body.p: This Response is to the Non-Final Office Action dated September 11, 2024. Claims 24 to 45 are pending, and Claims 29, 33, and 39 stand rejected. In this response, Claims 29, 33, and 39 are hereby amended for clarity. No new matter has been added by the amendments. Favorable reconsideration is respectfully requested.
Please charge Deposit Account No. 02-1818 for any fees associated with this Response. If any such charges are applied, please indicate Attorney Docket No. 3724361.00429 on the account statement.

The Office Action acknowledges Applicant's foreign priority but indicated that a certified copy of the Italian application is required. Applicant respectfully submits that the certified copy of IT102019000016787 has been filed.

The Office Action rejected Claims 29, 33, and 39 as allegedly indefinite. For example, the Office Action asserts that there is insufficient antecedent basis for "said at least one optical detector" as recited in Claims 29 and 33. Further, the Office Action asserts that it is unclear whether Claim 39 is attempting to further limit the detectors of Claim 24 or reciting additional detectors from Claim 24. In response, Applicant has amended Claims 29, 33, and 39 to ensure proper antecedent basis and address the indefiniteness rejections. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests the indefiniteness rejections be reconsidered and withdrawn.

For the foregoing reasons, Applicant respectfully submits that the present application is in condition for allowance and earnestly solicits reconsideration of same. Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions regarding this Response.
Respectfully submitted, K&L Gates LLPBY /Dennis A. Majewski/Dennis A. MajewskiReg. No. 65,578Telephone No. 312-807-4329Customer No. 29178
